items.title: Horn Shirley — Smithsonian Jazz Oral History
items.q: Oh, I didn‘t study with him, but I was really influenced. I heard him, Dr. Tibbs. He played the organ. He played the pipe organ and stuff, and he showed me things, you know.

ctx.x: If we can just return to the church for a minute, was there anyone else in the church who was instrumental in teaching you, or in showing you things, perhaps the choirmaster there?
